cœlo, pisces in aqua, creaturæ inanimæ & animatæ

page.notes: The Greek words are copied as printed; the accents on αὐτοδίδακτοι and αὐτοδιδάκτων are as far as they can be read. A small bullet stands before "rogatus" and another after "ali-" at the right edge; these may be reference marks, but they are not clear enough to place as braces. Italic and underlined passages are copied as italic; the underlining is not marked. Several words in the left note on section V and the note on "Pauci sunt" are read from small type and should be checked. Left margin, two notes: "Antonii E-remitæ di-ctum." (top, beside first line) and "Liber na-turæ." (beside "paginis, & totidem literis"). The second note is placed at its line within the paragraph. The first note has no reference mark in the text. "Qua" in "Qua de re" is underlined in the print. Small printed ornaments at the lower right are not text and are not transcribed.
